added_failures_note: the reviewed node ran an evidence gate (domain-groups.py --check), not a test suite, and its manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite from which a failure delta could be taken; domain-groups-gate.log records five PASS lines and EXIT=0, so no failure was added

findings.text: blocking: `by_group[name_group[name]].append(name)` appends once per family path, so a name produced from two paths of the same family is counted twice in one group. 35 of the 225 families are affected: the data lists `radial_magnetic_field` twice under equilibrium for `edge_profiles/ggd/b_field`, the page renders that family at sagr-domain-groups.html:329 with the name repeated and "equilibrium 5" where four distinct names exist, and `named_members` and `clearing.moves` are inflated from the same counts; the families touching equilibrium are a named done_when deliverable, so the repeated entry and the overstated counts are a wrong figure in the ruled evidence.

non-blocking: spearman and its _average_ranks helper duplicate imas_codex/standard_names/benchmark_roles.py:175 spearman_rho, an importable owner with its own test (tests/standard_names/test_benchmark_spearman.py) whose tie handling is identical; the sibling blind-audit.py:236 already imports from that module, so the local copy is an unforced capability fork.

non-blocking: wilson duplicates the interval blind-audit.py:672 owns in the same plan's section-1 fragment; the two now define the audit's 95 percent interval independently, and a later correction to one will not reach the other.

non-blocking: OUT_JSON and OUT_HTML are written before the checks at line 1383 are evaluated, so a run whose instrument fails still overwrites the committed evidence page and data, and the only trace of the failure is the exit code a caller must not ignore.

non-blocking: `_revision()` reads git HEAD at run time, so the committed page can never name the commit that carries it; the evidence page at sagr-domain-groups.html:439 names 61e0027cf while the file itself lands in c90b7997b, and every future re-run will need the same extra stamp commit.
